prompt:
Default behavior (enforceable, but no early rejects)

Primary objective
- Maximize CLIP image–text similarity (primary). SigLIP is diagnostic only.

High-level policy
- Never return "image unclear" prior to generating rerankable candidates. Always produce up to 3 deterministic candidate caption proposals, then apply CLIP-based reranking/acceptance logic (or calibrated heuristic if reranker is unavailable). Only return "image unclear" after candidates + reranking + margin logic and formatting/unit checks fail.

Canonical vocabulary: CLIP-validated whitelist (mandatory, empirical)
- Integrator MUST run per-surface-token CLIP validation on dev and label each surface-token as keep (CLIP-preferred), neutral, or demote/remove based on average CLIP delta and stability.
- Generator SHOULD use keep tokens by default. Use neutral tokens only for candidate generation when no clear keep exists for a required slot; neutral usage must be logged per-example for later pruning.
- Do NOT hard-block candidate generation when a keep verb is absent; instead include neutral/fallback verbs in candidate set (dev-validated) before rejecting.

Tokenization-normalization (must-match CLIP tokenizer)
- Define and use the exact same normalization as the CLIP tokenizer used for reranking:
  - Unicode normalization (NFC), lowercase, collapse repeated whitespace to single space, normalize hyphens to ASCII hyphen, strip surrounding punctuation except permitted terminal period, and canonicalize diacritics consistently.
- Document and version the normalization function. Log normalized strings used for all subject-matching and whitelist checks.

Output format (strict but generation-first)
- Emit exactly one final candidate (two-line format) when accepted; otherwise return exactly and only:
image unclear
- Candidate format (for each generated candidate):
  Line 1: exactly 3 canonical tags by default, comma-separated, no trailing comma. Hyphens allowed for multiword tokens.
  Line 2: one concise sentence ending with a single period.

Line 1 (tags) — conservative defaults, validated expansion allowed
- Default: exactly 3 tags, ordered:
  1) primary object token — REQUIRED and should be supported by detector_primary_tag_threshold.
  2) action token — include only if action_detector_confidence ≥ action_inclusion_threshold AND token ∈ keep ∪ (neutral if no keep and neutral-allowed-dev-flag true).
  3) one salient attribute token — exactly one of {color OR count OR position}, chosen from keep ∪ neutral (neutral only when no keep exists).
- Allow deterministic expansion to 4 tags when BOTH:
  a) every extra tag has detector_confidence ≥ high_confidence_threshold, AND
  b) per-token CLIP benefit validated on dev (positive delta & stability).
- Scene/texture tokens are allowed only if validated (keep) for the primary id and detector_confidence ≥ scene_inclusion_threshold.
- No synonyms/repeats within a candidate; synonyms may appear across different candidates only if CLIP-validated.

Line 2 (caption) — subject-first, CLIP-validated verbs, but candidates may vary
- Must begin with the primary Line1 tag's preferred-surface-token AFTER tokenization-normalization (subject-first constraint). Normalize both sides with the CLIP tokenizer; if mismatch is purely cosmetic (hyphenation/case/Unicode), allow soft match (log the cosmetic diffs) rather than immediate rejection.
- Sentence shape: [Subject] [active-verb] [object/relationship (optional)] [single salient attribute phrase]. Use active verbs from the CLIP-validated verb-list (keep preferred). If no keep verbs available for this primary, include neutral/fallback verbs in candidates (must be dev-validated).
- Include exactly ONE salient attribute and reuse the exact attribute token from Line 1.
- Target token length: 10–13 tokens. Hard max: 15 tokens. Fewer tokens allowed only if constraints satisfied.
- No commas, no lists, no subordinate clauses, no speculative language. End with a single period and no extra punctuation.

Candidate generation (unconditional) and deterministic variation
- Always generate up to 3 deterministic candidates before any verifier rejection. Candidate variations MUST include:
  a) alternate CLIP-validated attribute tokens or attribute types (color/count/position) when available;
  b) alternate CLIP-validated verbs (keep or neutral/fallback when no keep) for the primary id;
  c) alternate CLIP-preferred synonym variants for Line1 tags when CLIP-validated.
- Permit Line2 surface-level variation across candidates (verbs, attribute words, small permissible reorderings while keeping subject-first). Do not lock Line2 identical across candidates.
- All candidate generation must be deterministic (canonical priority lists, tie-breakers documented).

Reranking and acceptance (must-run)
- If any CLIP reranker is available (external or internal), rerank all generated candidates with CLIP and choose the highest-scoring candidate.
- Internal CLIP reranker is REQUIRED if external reranker unavailable. If NO CLIP reranker exists at all, use the calibrated internal heuristic (see fallback) but log reranker_absent and proceed cautiously.
- After reranking, apply acceptance checks (formatting, subject-match, thresholds, margin logic). Only then may "image unclear" be returned.

Acceptance thresholds and margin-based acceptance
- Default starting clip_threshold = 0.20 (integrator must sweep [0.20,0.24] on dev and set final value).
- If top_CLIP ≥ clip_threshold → accept (subject to format/unit tests).
- If top_CLIP < clip_threshold: allow margin-based acceptance when BOTH:
  a) top_vs_next_margin ≥ margin_accept_threshold (tunable on dev), AND
  b) TagPrecisionScore (per-token grounding) is high (tuned threshold).
  Require dev evidence to enable margin_accept_path for production. Log per-example reasoning.
- Only after reranking + margin logic fails should the verifier return "image unclear".

No-reranker heuristic (calibrated fallback; used only when reranker absent)
- Score = w1 * TagPrecisionScore + w2 * RerankMarginProxy - w3 * LengthPenalty - w4 * SubjectMismatchPenalty
  - Default weight hints (integrator must retune on dev): increase TagPrecision and RerankMarginProxy importance; increase SubjectMismatchPenalty for substantive mismatches but ignore cosmetic tokenization diffs.
  - LengthPenalty = max(0, token_count - 13).
  - SubjectMismatchPenalty = 0 if normalized(Line2 subject) == normalized(Line1 primary) or only cosmetic diffs; else 1.
  - RerankMarginProxy = normalized difference between best and second-best TagPrecisionScore.
- Tune weights on dev to maximize correlation with CLIP ranking; log calibration results.

Verifier / "image unclear" (conservative, enforced but post-generation)
- After candidate generation and reranking/fallback, return exactly and only:
image unclear
  if ANY of these apply:
  1) No primary object detected above detector_primary_tag_threshold AND no high-confidence alternative primary candidate exists in generated candidates.
  2) After CLIP reranking: top candidate CLIP score < clip_threshold AND (top_vs_next_margin < margin_accept_threshold OR TagPrecisionScore insufficient). (If reranker absent: analogous check using tuned heuristic and heuristic_accept_threshold.)
  3) Any strict formatting/unit test fails after normalization and cosmetic-tolerant subject match rules are applied (Line1 tags not all in keep ∪ allowed-neutral per dev policy, Line1 tag count ≠ required unless validated expansion allowed, Line2 contains commas/multiple attributes, Line2 token_count > 15, or Line2 verb is disallowed by dev policy).
  4) Active-verb unavailability: no verb (keep or neutral/fallback validated) included in any candidate and no dev-approved fallback exists.
- When returning "image unclear", output exactly that string and nothing else.

Formatting and automated checks (programmatic)
- Unit tests (must-run after reranking/fallback):
  1) Whitelist/CLIP-preference check: every Line1 tag ∈ keep ∪ allowed-neutral-for-this-id (as documented for dev); otherwise candidate may still be allowed if neutral was explicitly used by generation policy, but must be logged.
  2) Tag count and composition: default exactly 3 tags; expansions only allowed per validated expansion rule.
  3) Subject reuse check: normalized(Line2 subject) must match normalized Line1 primary. If mismatch is cosmetic (hyphens/case/Unicode), allow and log; if substantive, fail.
  4) Length check: token_count(Line2) ≤ 15; prefer 10–13.
  5) No commas; no trailing commas; Line2 ends with single period.
  6) Active-verb check: at least one candidate must contain a verb that is keep or neutral/fallback per dev validation; final chosen candidate verb must be permitted under dev policy.
  7) Grounding check: detector confidences for included tags must meet thresholds (unless neutral tokens were used per dev fallback rules).
  8) Tokenization-normalization check: ensure normalization identical to CLIP tokenizer; log mismatches. Cosmetic mismatches should not cause immediate failure.
- If automated checks fail after full candidate generation + reranking + margin path, return "image unclear". Do not auto-repair formatting beyond canonical normalization.

Thresholds, calibration, and dev validation (must-run before deployment)
- Required dev sweeps:
  - Sweep clip_threshold in [0.20, 0.24] and set value that optimizes mean_CLIP vs coverage.
  - Sweep action_inclusion_threshold, scene_inclusion_threshold, detector_primary_tag_threshold; choose conservative defaults balancing coverage.
  - Set margin_accept_threshold and require dev evidence for its use.
  - Build per-primary-id keep/neutral/demote verb and attribute lists via per-surface-token CLIP ablation; lock keep tokens only when deltas are positive and stable.
  - Tune no-reranker heuristic weights to correlate with CLIP rankings.
  - Validate expansion rules (4th tag) with per-token CLIP delta checks.

Telemetry and diagnostics (mandatory logging)
- For every captioning decision log:
  - All generated candidates (Line1+Line2), normalized forms, and which tokens were keep vs neutral.
  - Candidate-level CLIP scores and margins; final chosen candidate and score.
  - Per-token average CLIP contribution (from dev) and per-example per-token CLIP deltas (if reranker used).
  - Detector confidences for all candidate tags.
  - Final decision and single failure reason if returning "image unclear" (detector_low_confidence, clip_threshold_fail, margin_reject, formatting_check_fail, verb_unavailable, subject_mismatch_substantive, etc.).
  - Flag reranker_absent when applicable and store heuristic scores used.
  - Aggregate metrics: frequency of "image unclear" and breakdown by failure reason; per-token pruning suggestions.

Operational notes and rationale
- Deterministic generation must be preserved (canonical priority lists, tie-breakers) while allowing CLIP-validated lexical variation to surface for reranking.
- Prefer higher-precision validated tokens but permit neutral/fallback candidates when keep tokens do not exist for common primaries.
- Regularly re-run per-token CLIP validation when CLIP model versions or surfaced data change.

Final requirement
- If, after unconditional candidate generation, reranking/fallback, margin consideration, and formatting/unit checks (with cosmetic-tolerant subject matching), no acceptable candidate remains, output exactly and only:
image unclear
